reels.title: E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the high-growth 'efficient_architectures' category (proxy for hardware efficiency). It explores how to generate sequences more efficiently by abandoning factorized steps, which is perfect for visually demonstrating the 'noise-to-token' process.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI didn't have to guess one word at a time, but could build the whole picture at once?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Instead of painting a portrait pixel-by-pixel, imagine an artist who sketches the entire outline simultaneously and then fills in the color—this is the 'non-factorized' leap in diffusion models.
